name: Order Status 11 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of an order.

IMPL.name: Implied Strategy Orders
IMPL.definition: Used for strategy orders that are derived from implied in or implied out functionality.

INDI.name: Indicative Quotes
INDI.definition: Quotes that are visible but cannot be executed. Includes warrants in some trading venue.

ROUT.name: Routed Orders
ROUT.definition: Orders that are routed by the trading venue to other venues.
